        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_g13_after','shop_a','191167');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_g13_after';")
    record(group, "after_overlap_unattributed_successor_allowed", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_g13_null","WEBHOOK","wh_null","digest_null",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", admitted_at_sql="NULL")
    rc, out, err = runtime_guard("work_g13_null")
    record(group, "missing_payload_time_ambiguous", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    psql(
        "pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"PrivacyCompletedTarget\"(\"shopId\",\"generationId\",\"targetKind\",\"targetValue\",\"privacyRequestId\",\"completedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('shop_a','gen_a2','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167','preq_multi', clock_timestamp() - interval '90 minutes') "
        "ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;",
    )
    rc, out, err = runtime_guard("work_g13_wh_old")
    record(group, "multiple_applicable_completions_still_ambiguous", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = runtime_guard("work_g13_wh_old")
    record(group, "delayed_retry_preserves_original_admission_still_ambiguous", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    psql(
        "pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('gen_a3','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','shop_a','LIVE', clock_timestamp() - interval '30 minutes');",
    )
    rc, out, err = runtime_guard("work_g13_wh_old")
    record(group, "concurrent_reinstall_unattributed_overlap_not_admitted",
           rc != 0 and ("customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err or "customer_write_origin_ambiguous" in err),
           err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    psql("pr45owner", "DELETE FROM public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" WHERE id='gen_a3';")

    admit("shop_b","pr7-b.myshopify.com","work_g13_b","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_b","digest_b",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", req="preq_dr", att="patt_dr")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_b","preq_dr","patt_dr",
        gsql("pr7-b.myshopify.com","shop_b","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_g13_b")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_g13_b','shop_b','191167');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_g13_b';")
    record(group, "unrelated_shop_progresses_during_overlap_block", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_g13_other","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_other","digest_other",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","work_g13_other")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_g13_other','shop_a','999999');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_g13_other';")
    record(group, "unrelated_customer_progresses", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")

    reset()
    tx("stocky_privacy_erasure","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_privacy_install_customer_barrier('preq_cr','patt_cr');"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_enumerate_targets('preq_cr');"
        " DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderLineFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"AuditEvent\";"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_complete_customer_redact('preq_cr','patt_cr');")
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"PrivacyCompletedTarget\"(\"shopId\",\"generationId\",\"targetKind\",\"targetValue\",\"privacyRequestId\",\"completedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('shop_a','gen_missing_history','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167','preq_missing', clock_timestamp() - interval '1 hour');")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_g13_hist","WEBHOOK","wh_hist","digest_hist",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="clock_timestamp() - interval '1 hour'")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
                      gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_g13_hist"))
    record(group, "missing_generation_history_not_a_permit", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))


def g14() -> None:
    """GW-02 source-derived coverage reconciliation. Required set is not the inventory rows."""
    group = "G14-source-coverage"
    reset()
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "source_derived_complete_true", out.strip() in ("t", "true"), out)
    rc, nreq, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"SourceDerivedRequired\";")
    rc, ninv, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"ParticipatingWriterInventory\";")
    record(group, "required_set_not_empty_and_not_from_inventory_count", int(nreq.strip()) >= 13 and nreq.strip() != ninv.strip(), f"required={nreq} inventory={ninv}")
    rc, unk, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\" WHERE classification='UNKNOWN';")
    record(group, "no_unknown_candidates", unk.strip() == "0", unk)

    # Floor still holds.
    rc, floor, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_floor_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "seven_symbol_floor_true", floor.strip() in ("t", "true"), floor)

    symbols = [
        "completeAttemptRetry",
        "dispatcher_disabled_shop_path",
        "withTenantBoundTransaction",
        "claimAttempt",
        "enqueueWithDispatch",
        "runOrderFactsSyncJob",
        "computeSyncHealth",
        "runOrderFactsReconcileJob",
        "applyNominatedOrderGid",
        "applyWithApplicationReceipt",
        "lockSyncRun",
        "upsertCanonicalShop",
        "processUninstall",
    ]
    saved = {}
    for sym in symbols:
        rc, dump, err = psql(
            "pr45owner",
            "COPY (SELECT * FROM public.\"ParticipatingWriterInventory\" WHERE symbol='%s') TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER false);"
            % sym,
        )
        saved[sym] = dump
        psql("pr45owner", "DELETE FROM public.\"ParticipatingWriterInventory\" WHERE symbol='%s';" % sym)
        rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
        record(group, f"inventory_incomplete_when_{sym}_removed", out.strip() in ("f", "false"), out)
        reset()

    # Inject unlisted raw-SQL / aliased / wrapped / route-TSX writers into the independent required set.
    injects = [
        ("probe|raw_sql|INSERT|ShopifyOrderFact", "app/lib/probe/raw.sql.ts", "rawInsert", "WRITE", "REQUIRED_LIFECYCLE_AND_TARGET"),
        ("probe|alias_wrapped|upsert|shopSettings", "app/lib/probe/alias.ts", "wrappedUpsert", "WRITE", "REQUIRED_LIFECYCLE"),
        ("app/routes/probe.tsx|action|create|purchaseOrder", "app/routes/probe.tsx", "action", "WRITE", "REQUIRED_LIFECYCLE"),
    ]
    reset()
    for ident, path, symbol, scan_kind, clf in injects:
        psql(
            "pr45owner",
            "INSERT INTO public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\"(source_identity,file_path,symbol,write_site,operation,surface,blob_sha256,scan_kind,classification,covered_host_identity,classification_reason,evidence) "
            f"VALUES ('{ident}','{path}','{symbol}','L1','insert','probe','00','{scan_kind}','{clf}','probe host','injected unlisted writer','probe');"
            "INSERT INTO public.\"SourceDerivedRequired\"(source_identity,file_path,symbol,write_site,operation,surface) "
            f"VALUES ('{ident}','{path}','{symbol}','L1','insert','probe');",
        )
        rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
        record(group, f"unlisted_{symbol}_blocks_completeness", out.strip() in ("f", "false"), out)
        psql("pr45owner", f"DELETE FROM public.\"SourceDerivedRequired\" WHERE source_identity='{ident}'; DELETE FROM public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\" WHERE source_identity='{ident}';")

    # Misclassify a genuine WRITE as read-only.
    reset()
    rc, ident, _ = psql(
        "pr45owner",
        "SELECT source_identity FROM public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\" WHERE scan_kind='WRITE' AND classification LIKE 'REQUIRED%' LIMIT 1;",
    )
    ident = ident.strip()
    psql("pr45owner", "UPDATE public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\" SET classification='READ_ONLY' WHERE source_identity='%s';" % ident.replace("'", "''"))
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "misclassify_write_as_readonly_incomplete", out.strip() in ("f", "false"), out)

    # Stale SOURCE_SITE mapping.
    reset()
    psql(
        "pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"ParticipatingWriterInventory\"(file_path,symbol,transaction_host,role_name,surfaces,target_key_derivation,guard_lock_order,processing_enabled_on_v,already_running_outcome,disabled_frozen_behavior,integration_test_home,source_identity,mapping_kind) "
        "VALUES ('app/gone.ts','gone','none','stocky_runtime','x','x','REQUIRED','x','x','x','x','stale::gone::mapping','SOURCE_SITE');",
    )
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "stale_source_mapping_incomplete", out.strip() in ("f", "false"), out)

    # Unknown candidate blocks completeness.
    reset()
    psql(
        "pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\"(source_identity,file_path,symbol,write_site,operation,surface,blob_sha256,scan_kind,classification,covered_host_identity,classification_reason,evidence) "
        "VALUES ('probe|dyn|UNKNOWN|x','app/dyn.ts','dyn','L1','dynamic','x','00','UNKNOWN','UNKNOWN','x','unresolved alias','x');",
    )
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "unknown_candidate_blocks_completeness", out.strip() in ("f", "false"), out)

    # Empty required table must not report complete (cannot derive expectation from inventory).
    reset()
    psql("pr45owner", "DELETE FROM public.\"SourceDerivedRequired\";")
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "empty_required_set_is_not_complete", out.strip() in ("f", "false"), out)

    # Nonwriter injection does not create a phantom required writer.
    reset()
    psql(
        "pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"SourceDerivedCandidate\"(source_identity,file_path,symbol,write_site,operation,surface,blob_sha256,scan_kind,classification,covered_host_identity,classification_reason,evidence) "
        "VALUES ('probe|read|SELECT|Shop','app/read.ts','loadShop','L1','select','Shop','00','READ','NONWRITER','n/a','read-only','x');",
    )
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "nonwriter_does_not_phantom_required", out.strip() in ("t", "true"), out)

    reset()
    psql("pr45owner", "DELETE FROM public.\"ParticipatingWriterInventory\" WHERE symbol='getShopHealth';")
    rc, out, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT public.stocky_inventory_is_complete()::text;")
    record(group, "historical_getShopHealth_still_not_required", out.strip() in ("t", "true"), out)




def g15() -> None:
    """TA-01 producer/consumer admission binding."""
    group = "G15-durable-origin"
    reset()
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"shopId\",\"workId\",\"sourceKind\",\"sourceIdentity\",\"originalAdmissionId\",\"formatPolicyVersion\",\"sourceContentDigest\",\"originStatus\") "
        "VALUES ('x','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w','ADMIN_ACTION','s','x','pr7-origin-v1','d','BOUND');")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_origin_insert", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"shopId\",\"workId\",\"sourceKind\",\"sourceIdentity\",\"originalAdmissionId\",\"formatPolicyVersion\",\"sourceContentDigest\",\"originStatus\") "
        "VALUES ('y','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w2','ADMIN_ACTION','s2','y','pr7-origin-v1','d2','BOUND');")
    record(group, "control_plane_denied_origin_insert", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "UPDATE public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" SET \"originGenerationId\"='gen_a2';")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_origin_update", is_denied(rc, err) or "0" in last_line(out), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "DELETE FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\";")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_origin_delete", is_denied(rc, err) or last_line(out) in ("0",""), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w_rt','ADMIN_ACTION','s_rt','d_rt','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), 'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_helper_execute", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w_cp','ADMIN_ACTION','s_cp','d_cp','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), 'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "control_plane_denied_helper_execute", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr", "SET ROLE stocky_original_admission;")
    record(group, "runtime_cannot_set_role_admission", rc != 0, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT set_config('stocky.origin_generation_id','gen_a2', true); SELECT current_setting('stocky.origin_generation_id', true);")
    record(group, "guc_is_not_admission_authority", rc == 0, "GUC may be set but is ignored by helpers")

    # Legitimate admission then consumer use.
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_legit","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_legit","digest_legit",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "original_admission_helper_creates_binding", rc == 0, f"out={out} err={err}")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_legit")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_legit_adm','shop_a','191167');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_legit_adm';")
    record(group, "consumer_uses_persisted_binding", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")

    # Same-source retry preserves origin/time.
    rc1, orig_at, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"originalAdmittedAt\"::text||','||\"originGenerationId\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_legit';")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_legit_retry","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_legit","digest_legit",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="clock_timestamp() + interval '1 day'")
    rc2, after_at, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"originalAdmittedAt\"::text||','||\"originGenerationId\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_legit';")
    record(group, "retry_same_source_preserves_origin_time", rc == 0 and orig_at.strip() == after_at.strip() and orig_at.strip() != "", f"before={orig_at} after={after_at} err={err}")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_legit_changed","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_legit","digest_legit_CHANGED",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc3, after_conflict, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"sourceContentDigest\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_legit';")
    record(group, "changed_digest_conflicts_original_unchanged", rc != 0 and "admission_binding_conflict" in err and "digest_legit" in after_conflict, f"err={err} digest={after_conflict}")

    # Tenant / target / work substitution.
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","work_legit"))
    record(group, "target_substitution_rejected", rc != 0 and "customer_target_binding_mismatch" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_b","preq_dr","patt_dr",
        gsql("pr7-b.myshopify.com","shop_b","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_legit"))
    record(group, "tenant_substitution_rejected", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_does_not_exist"))
    record(group, "missing_binding_fail_closed", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Borrow successor work for CE-D target after overlap fixture.
    reset()
    tx("stocky_privacy_erasure","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_privacy_install_customer_barrier('preq_cr','patt_cr');"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_enumerate_targets('preq_cr');"
        " DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderLineFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"AuditEvent\";"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_complete_customer_redact('preq_cr','patt_cr');")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_borrow_old","WEBHOOK","wh_borrow_old","digest_borrow_old",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="clock_timestamp() - interval '150 minutes'")
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('gen_a2','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','shop_a','LIVE', clock_timestamp() - interval '3 hours'); "
        "UPDATE public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" SET fence='UNINSTALLED', \"shopRowId\"=NULL WHERE id='gen_a'; "
        "UPDATE public.\"PrivacyCompletedTarget\" SET \"completedAt\" = clock_timestamp() - interval '2 hours' "
        "WHERE \"generationId\"='gen_a' AND \"targetKind\"='CUSTOMER_REST_ID' AND \"targetValue\"='191167';")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_borrow_succ","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_borrow_succ","digest_borrow_succ",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_borrow_succ"))
    record(group, "successor_binding_is_not_interchangeable_with_old_digest", rc == 0, "successor work may use its own binding")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_borrow_old"))
    record(group, "borrowed_successor_cannot_admit_ced_payload", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Unknown delayed first-seen webhook after reinstall stays unattributed.
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_delayed_wh","WEBHOOK","wh_delayed_new","digest_delayed_new",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="clock_timestamp() - interval '150 minutes'")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_delayed_wh"))
    record(group, "delayed_first_seen_webhook_not_promoted", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Child cannot launder old digest via trusted parent.
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_child_launder","CHILD","child_launder","digest_borrow_old",
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", parent="work_borrow_succ")
    record(group, "child_cannot_launder_old_digest", rc != 0, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_child_ok","CHILD","child_ok","digest_borrow_succ",
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", parent="work_borrow_succ")
    record(group, "child_inherits_parent_origin", rc == 0, err)

    # Pending link is not trusted until commit; recover after job exists.
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"DurableJob\"(id,\"shopId\",\"jobType\",state) "
        "VALUES ('job_pend','shop_a','admitted:ADMIN_ACTION','PENDING') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_pend","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_pend","digest_pend",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999",
          job="job_pend", mode="BEGIN")
    record(group, "begin_pending_link", rc == 0, err)
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","work_pend"))
    record(group, "pending_link_not_trusted_for_effects", rc != 0 and "customer_admission_not_acked" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_recover_writer_admission('work_pend');")
    record(group, "recover_unacked_admission_with_job", rc == 0, err)
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","work_pend")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_pend','shop_a','999999');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_pend';")
    record(group, "recovered_admission_allows_consumer", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")

    # Duplicate concurrent admission of the same source+digest.
    def _adm1() -> None:
        admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_dup_a","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_dup","digest_dup",
              "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    def _adm2() -> None:
        admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_dup_b","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_dup","digest_dup",
              "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    t1 = threading.Thread(target=_adm1); t2 = threading.Thread(target=_adm2)
    t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(10); t2.join(10)
    rc, n, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"sourceIdentity\"='admin_dup';")
    record(group, "duplicate_concurrent_admission_reconciles", n.strip() == "1", n)

    # Pruned binding.
    psql("pr45owner", "DELETE FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOriginTarget\" WHERE \"originId\" LIKE 'wao_work_legit%'; DELETE FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_legit';")
    # work_legit was on previous reset; recreate then prune on current fixture:
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_prune","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_prune","digest_prune",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    psql("pr45owner", "DELETE FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOriginTarget\" t USING public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" o WHERE t.\"originId\"=o.id AND o.\"workId\"='work_prune'; DELETE FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_prune';")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","work_prune"))
    record(group, "pruned_binding_fail_closed", rc != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Genuine successor after completion.
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_new_succ","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_new_succ","digest_new_succ",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="clock_timestamp() + interval '1 second'")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_new_succ")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_new_succ','shop_a','191167');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_new_succ';")
    record(group, "genuine_successor_after_completion_progresses", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")

    # Two-session admission vs barrier: barrier still wins on matching target.
    reset()
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_vs_bar","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_vs_bar","digest_vs_bar",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    started = threading.Event(); outcome: dict[str, str] = {}
    def reinstall() -> None:
        started.wait(5)
        psql("pr45owner",
            "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "
            "VALUES ('gen_race','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','shop_a','LIVE', clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;")
        outcome["insert"] = "ok"
    def barrier() -> None:
        started.set()
        rc_b, out_b, err_b = tx("stocky_privacy_erasure","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
            "SELECT public.stocky_privacy_install_customer_barrier('preq_cr','patt_cr');")
        outcome["barrier_rc"] = str(rc_b); outcome["barrier_err"] = err_b[:200]
    t1 = threading.Thread(target=reinstall); t2 = threading.Thread(target=barrier)
    t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(10); t2.join(10)
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_vs_bar"))
    record(group, "admission_cannot_outrun_active_barrier",
           outcome.get("barrier_rc") == "0" and rc != 0 and "customer_target_erasing" in err,
           f"barrier={outcome} err={err[:300]}", sqlstate_from_err(err))

    admit("shop_b","pr7-b.myshopify.com","work_b_ok","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_b_ok","digest_b_ok",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", req="preq_dr", att="patt_dr")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_b","preq_dr","patt_dr",
        gsql("pr7-b.myshopify.com","shop_b","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_b_ok")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_g15_b','shop_b','191167');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_g15_b';")
    record(group, "unrelated_shop_progresses_with_own_binding", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")



def host_apply(
    shop: str,
    domain: str,
    kind: str,
    value: str,
    work_id: str,
    effect_id: str,
    req: str = "preq_cr",
    att: str = "patt_cr",
    *,
    use_guc_locator: bool = False,
    callback_effect_id: str | None = None,
    source_body: str = "",
    operation: str = "CUSTOMER_WRITE",
) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    """Freeze the semantic write snapshot and write THAT snapshot.

    callback_effect_id models an after-check / alternate callback payload.
    The correct host ignores it. use_guc_locator sets the untrusted GUC
    instead of passing p_work_id (AO-04); the host still revalidates.
    """
    snapshot = {
        "domain": domain,
        "shop": shop,
        "kind": kind,
        "value": value,
        "effect_id": effect_id,
        "work_id": work_id,
    }
    write_effect = snapshot["effect_id"]
    _ = callback_effect_id  # attacker-controlled extra; must not be written
    if use_guc_locator:
        sql = (
            f"SELECT set_config('stocky.trusted_work_id', '{snapshot['work_id']}', true);"
            f" SELECT public.stocky_apply_bound_customer_effect("
            f"'{snapshot['domain']}','{snapshot['shop']}','{snapshot['kind']}',"
            f"'{snapshot['value']}','{write_effect}', NULL, '{operation}', '{source_body}');"
            f" SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='{write_effect}';"
        )
    else:
        sql = (
            f"SELECT public.stocky_apply_bound_customer_effect("
            f"'{snapshot['domain']}','{snapshot['shop']}','{snapshot['kind']}',"
            f"'{snapshot['value']}','{write_effect}','{snapshot['work_id']}',"
            f"'{operation}','{source_body}');"
            f" SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='{write_effect}';"
        )
    return tx("stocky_runtime", shop, req, att, sql)


def host_apply_mutated_callback(
    shop: str, domain: str, kind: str, value: str, work_id: str,
    snapshot_effect_id: str, callback_effect_id: str,
    req: str = "preq_cr", att: str = "patt_cr",
    source_body: str = "",
    operation: str = "CUSTOMER_WRITE",
) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    """Attack helper: pass mutated callback bytes as the effect identity."""
    sql = (
        f"SELECT public.stocky_apply_bound_customer_effect("
        f"'{domain}','{shop}','{kind}','{value}','{callback_effect_id}','{work_id}',"
        f"'{operation}','{source_body}');"
        f" SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='{callback_effect_id}';"
        f" SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='{snapshot_effect_id}';"
    )
    return tx("stocky_runtime", shop, req, att, sql)





def g16() -> None:
    """DO-01 authenticated original-admin capture; DO-02 effect-host binding."""
    group = "G16-admin-origin-effect-host"
    reset()

    # Direct producer ADMIN without capture.
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w_nocap','ADMIN_ACTION','s_nocap','d_nocap','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), 'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "admin_class_without_capture_rejected", rc != 0 and "admission_admin_capture_required" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_establish_modeled_admin_session('shop_a','pr7-a.myshopify.com','actor_a');")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_establish_admin_session", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_capture_original_admin_command('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','cmd_x','ADMIN_ACTION','s_x','d_x','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167');")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_capture_execute", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_capture_original_admin_command('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','cmd_y','ADMIN_ACTION','s_y','d_y','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167');")
    record(group, "control_plane_denied_capture_execute", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_capture_original_admin_command('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','cmd_z','ADMIN_ACTION','s_z','d_z','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167');")
    record(group, "producer_denied_capture_execute", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_admin_capture","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_capture_original_admin_command('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','cmd_ns','ADMIN_ACTION','s_ns','d_ns','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167');")
    record(group, "capture_without_established_session_rejected", rc != 0 and "admission_admin_session_required" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_admin_capture","shop_b","preq_dr","patt_dr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_establish_modeled_admin_session('shop_a','pr7-a.myshopify.com','actor_a');")
    record(group, "capture_wrong_shop_session_rejected", rc != 0 and "admission_session_tenant_mismatch" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Caller timestamp is not provenance: capture now, admit with historical overlap time.
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_ts","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_ts","digest_ts",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:19:00+00'")
    rc2, row, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT to_char(\"originalAdmittedAt\" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')||','||\"originStatus\"||','||\"originGenerationId\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_ts';")
    record(group, "caller_overlap_timestamp_does_not_become_captured_at",
           rc == 0 and "2026-09-20 18:19" not in row and "BOUND,gen_a" in row, f"row={row} err={err}")

    # Label-only: webhook sighting then ADMIN capture of same identity.
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_wh_lab","WEBHOOK","wh_lab","digest_lab",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_admin_lab","WEBHOOK","wh_lab","digest_lab",
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "label_only_queued_webhook_cannot_capture_admin",
           rc != 0 and "queued_work_cannot_acquire_fresh_admin_origin" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Inbox sighting without prior origin.
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_note_queued_work('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','ADMIN_ACTION','admin_queued','digest_queued','QUEUED_INBOX');")
    record(group, "control_plane_can_note_queued_work", rc == 0, err)
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_queued","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_queued","digest_queued",
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "queued_inbox_cannot_acquire_fresh_admin_origin",
           rc != 0 and "queued_work_cannot_acquire_fresh_admin_origin" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_note_queued_work('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','ADMIN_ACTION','admin_rt','digest_rt','QUEUED_INBOX');")
    record(group, "runtime_denied_note_queued_work", is_denied(rc, err), err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Retry preserves capturedAt.
    rc1, orig_at, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"capturedAt\"::text FROM public.\"OriginalAdminCapture\" WHERE \"sourceIdentity\"='admin_ts';")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_ts_retry","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_ts","digest_ts",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="clock_timestamp() + interval '1 day'")
    rc2, after_at, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"capturedAt\"::text FROM public.\"OriginalAdminCapture\" WHERE \"sourceIdentity\"='admin_ts';")
    rc3, origin_at, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"originalAdmittedAt\"::text FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='work_ts';")
    record(group, "time_only_retry_does_not_restamp_capture",
           rc == 0 and orig_at.strip() == after_at.strip() and orig_at.strip() != "" and orig_at.strip() in origin_at,
           f"cap={orig_at}->{after_at} origin={origin_at} err={err}")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_ts_changed","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_ts","digest_ts_CHANGED",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "changed_digest_admin_conflicts", rc != 0 and "admission_binding_conflict" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Epoch mismatch: capture under gen_a, then reinstall, then producer.
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_epoch","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_epoch","digest_epoch",
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "capture_under_current_live", rc == 0, err)
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('gen_a2','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','shop_a','LIVE', clock_timestamp()); "
        "UPDATE public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" SET fence='UNINSTALLED', \"shopRowId\"=NULL WHERE id='gen_a';")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','work_epoch','ADMIN_ACTION','admin_epoch','digest_epoch','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), 'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "capture_epoch_mismatch_after_reinstall_rejected",
           rc != 0 and "admission_capture_epoch_mismatch" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Install lower-bound consistency (not provenance): capture then move installedAt into the future.
    reset()
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_preinst","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_preinst","digest_preinst",
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    psql("pr45owner", "UPDATE public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" SET \"installedAt\" = clock_timestamp() + interval '1 hour' WHERE id='gen_a';")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','work_preinst','ADMIN_ACTION','admin_preinst','digest_preinst','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), 'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "capture_before_install_consistency_rejected",
           rc != 0 and "admission_capture_before_install" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Review 17:49/18:19/18:49 fixture: SQL-only DO-02 + host binding. Do not
    # restamp completedAt before the honest unattributed overlap check.
    reset()
    tx("stocky_privacy_erasure","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_privacy_install_customer_barrier('preq_cr','patt_cr');"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_enumerate_targets('preq_cr');"
        " DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderLineFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"AuditEvent\";"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_complete_customer_redact('preq_cr','patt_cr');")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_old","WEBHOOK","wh_old","digest_old",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:19:00+00'")
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('gen_a2','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','shop_a','LIVE', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 17:49:00+00'); "
        "UPDATE public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" SET fence='UNINSTALLED', \"shopRowId\"=NULL WHERE id='gen_a'; "
        "UPDATE public.\"PrivacyCompletedTarget\" SET \"completedAt\" = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:49:00+00' "
        "WHERE \"generationId\"='gen_a' AND \"targetKind\"='CUSTOMER_REST_ID' AND \"targetValue\"='191167';")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w_admin_ov','ADMIN_ACTION','admin_ov','digest_ov','pr7-origin-v1', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:19:00+00', 'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "overlap_caller_timestamp_without_capture_rejected",
           rc != 0 and "admission_admin_capture_required" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_new","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_new","digest_new",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "genuine_admin_after_completion_progresses", rc == 0, err)
    rc_old, _, err_old = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_old"))
    rc_new, _, err_new = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_new"))
    record(group, "sql_honest_old_ambiguous_new_admitted",
           rc_old != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err_old and rc_new == 0,
           f"old={err_old[:120]} new={err_new[:120]}")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_new")
        + " INSERT INTO public.\"AuditEvent\"(id,\"shopId\",\"customerRestId\") VALUES ('ae_sql_switch','shop_a','191167');"
        + " SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_sql_switch';")
    record(group, "sql_only_old_effect_new_work_id_still_admitted",
           rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")

    # AO-02 + RE-02: G16 host path admits with computed SOURCE commitment.
    # Effect commitment stays separate (includes effectId). Matching write
    # lands FIRST so SourceEffectLink can deny later alternate payloads.
    src_ok = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","ao02-host-body")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_eff_ok","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_eff_ok",src_ok,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "effect_host_admits_computed_source_commitment", rc == 0, err)
    rc, sql_src, _ = psql("pr45owner",
        "SELECT public.stocky_source_commitment('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','CUSTOMER_WRITE','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167','ao02-host-body');")
    record(group, "python_and_sql_source_commitment_match",
           sql_src.strip() == src_ok == source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","ao02-host-body"),
           f"py={src_ok} sql={sql_src}")
    rc, sql_c, _ = psql("pr45owner",
        "SELECT public.stocky_effect_commitment('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167','ae_host_ok');")
    dg_ok = effect_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","ae_host_ok")
    record(group, "python_and_sql_effect_commitment_match",
           sql_c.strip() == dg_ok,
           f"py={dg_ok} sql={sql_c}")
    record(group, "source_and_effect_commitments_are_distinct",
           src_ok != dg_ok, f"src={src_ok} eff={dg_ok}")
    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_eff_ok","ae_host_ok",
                              source_body="ao02-host-body")
    record(group, "effect_host_accepts_matching_digest_and_writes",
           rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", f"out={out} err={err}")
    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_eff_ok","ae_host_ok2",
                              source_body="ao02-host-body")
    rc_n, n2nd, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_host_ok2';")
    record(group, "same_work_second_effect_id_denied_while_fresh",
           rc != 0 and "effect_digest_mismatch" in err and n2nd.strip() == "0",
           f"err={err} n={n2nd}", sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_new","ae_host_switch",
                              source_body="ao02-host-body")
    rc_n, n, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_host_switch';")
    record(group, "effect_host_rejects_old_effect_with_new_work_id",

    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_eff_ok","ae_substituted",

    rc_n, n, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_substituted';")

    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_eff_ok","ae_host_ok",
                              source_body="ao02-host-body")
    rc_n, n, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_host_ok';")
    record(group, "effect_host_rejects_altered_target_under_matching_work",
           rc != 0 and n.strip() == "1",
           f"err={err} n={n}", sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = host_apply_mutated_callback(
        "shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_eff_ok",
        "ae_host_ok","ae_callback_mut", source_body="ao02-host-body")
    rc_n, nmut, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_callback_mut';")
    record(group, "effect_host_rejects_after_check_mutated_callback_payload",
           rc != 0 and "effect_digest_mismatch" in err and nmut.strip() == "0",
           f"err={err} n={nmut}", sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_apply_bound_customer_effect('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167','ae_nobind', NULL);")
    record(group, "apply_without_execution_context_rejected",
           rc != 0 and "effect_execution_context_required" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_b","preq_dr","patt_dr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_bind_execution_context('w_new');")
    record(group, "bind_context_wrong_tenant_rejected",
           rc != 0 and "effect_execution_context_invalid" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Genuine ADMIN capture whose server clock lands inside an overlap window.
    reset()
    tx("stocky_privacy_erasure","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_privacy_install_customer_barrier('preq_cr','patt_cr');"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_enumerate_targets('preq_cr');"
        " DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderLineFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"AuditEvent\";"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_complete_customer_redact('preq_cr','patt_cr');")
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "
        "VALUES ('gen_a2','pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','shop_a','LIVE', clock_timestamp() - interval '30 minutes'); "
        "UPDATE public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" SET fence='UNINSTALLED', \"shopRowId\"=NULL WHERE id='gen_a'; "
        "UPDATE public.\"PrivacyCompletedTarget\" SET \"completedAt\" = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 minutes' "
        "WHERE \"generationId\"='gen_a' AND \"targetKind\"='CUSTOMER_REST_ID' AND \"targetValue\"='191167';")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_ov_real","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_ov_real","digest_ov_real",
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc2, row, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"originStatus\"||','||\"originGenerationId\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='w_ov_real';")
    rc3, gout, gerr = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",

           rc == 0 and row.strip() == "BOUND,gen_a2" and rc3 == 0, f"admit={err} row={row} guard={gerr}")

    # Unrelated shop positive.

    # AO-03 races: both orders. Invariant: never ADMIN-capture content that is already non-fresh.
    def _race(order: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        digest = "dg_race_" + order
        outcome: dict[str, str] = {}
        def sight() -> None:
            rc_s, _, err_s = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_race_"+order,"WEBHOOK","wh_race_"+order,digest,
                  "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
            outcome["sight_rc"] = str(rc_s); outcome["sight_err"] = err_s[:200]
        def cap() -> None:
            rc_c, _, err_c = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_race_cap_"+order,"ADMIN_ACTION","admin_race_"+order,digest,
                                         "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
            outcome["cap_rc"] = str(rc_c); outcome["cap_err"] = err_c[:200]
        if order == "sight_first":
            sight(); cap()
        else:
            cap(); sight()
        return outcome
    o1 = _race("sight_first")
    record(group, "race_sighting_then_capture_denies_admin",

    record(group, "re01_origin_remains_bound_historically", st2.strip() == "BOUND", st2)

    rc_st, st3, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"originStatus\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"=\'w_re01_ack\';")
    record(group, "re01_does_not_rewrite_bound_to_unattributed",

    src_win = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","re01-win")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_re01_win","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_re01_win",src_win,

    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_re01_win","ae_re01_win",

    record(group, "re01_effect_commits_while_still_fresh", rc == 0 and last_line(out) == "1", err)
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_note_queued_work('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','WEBHOOK','wh_re01_win',"

    rc2, n2, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_re01_win';")
    rc3, out3, err3 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_re01_win","ae_re01_win",

    # Sighting vs effect concurrent: each winner under source lock.
    reset()
    src_race = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","re01-racefx")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_re01_rfx","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_re01_rfx",src_race,

    # Sequential schedules (separate transactions; no lock held across orchestration).
    def _fx_then_sight() -> dict[str, str]:
        d: dict[str, str] = {}
        rc_a, _, err_a = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_re01_rfx","ae_rfx_a",

        rc_s, _, err_s = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
            "SELECT public.stocky_note_queued_work('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','WEBHOOK','wh_rfx',"
            f"'{src_race}','QUEUED_INBOX');")
        d["sight"] = str(rc_s); d["sight_err"] = err_s[:160]
        return d
    o_fx = _fx_then_sight()
    rc_n, nfx, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_rfx_a';")
    record(group, "race_effect_then_sighting_effect_wins",
           o_fx.get("apply") == "0" and o_fx.get("sight") == "0" and nfx.strip() == "1", str(o_fx)+" n="+nfx)

    reset()
    src_race2 = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","re01-racefx2")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_re01_rfx2","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_re01_rfx2",src_race2,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc_s, _, err_s = tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_note_queued_work('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','WEBHOOK','wh_rfx2',"
        f"'{src_race2}','QUEUED_INBOX');")
    rc_a, _, err_a = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_re01_rfx2","ae_rfx_b",
                                source_body="re01-racefx2")
    rc_n, nfx2, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_rfx_b';")
    record(group, "race_sighting_then_effect_sighting_wins",
           rc_s == 0 and rc_a != 0 and "effect_source_no_longer_fresh" in err_a and nfx2.strip() == "0",
           f"sight={err_s} apply={err_a} n={nfx2}")

    # Correlated child of the SAME accepted fresh command still progresses.
    reset()
    src_corr = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","corr-parent")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_corr_p","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_corr_p",src_corr,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_corr_c","CHILD","child_corr",src_corr,
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999", parent="w_corr_p")
    rc2, stc, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT \"originStatus\" FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"=\'w_corr_c\';")
    rc3, _, gerr = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_corr_c"))
    record(group, "correlated_child_of_fresh_admin_still_progresses",
           rc == 0 and stc.strip() == "BOUND" and rc3 == 0, f"admit={err} st={stc} guard={gerr}")
    # Parent capture remains eligible (child is correlated, not contradictory).
    rc4, out4, err4 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_corr_p","ae_corr_p",
                                 source_body="corr-parent")
    record(group, "correlated_child_does_not_contradict_parent_capture",
           rc4 == 0 and last_line(out4) == "1", err4)
    rc5, out5, err5 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_corr_c","ae_corr_child",
                                 source_body="corr-parent")
    rc_n, n5, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_corr_child';")
    record(group, "correlated_child_new_effect_id_after_parent_write_denied",
           rc5 != 0 and "effect_digest_mismatch" in err5 and n5.strip() == "0",
           f"err={err5} n={n5}", sqlstate_from_err(err5))
    rc6, out6, err6 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_corr_c","ae_corr_p",
                                 source_body="corr-parent")
    rc_n, n6, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_corr_p';")
    record(group, "correlated_child_same_effect_id_is_historical",
           rc6 == 0 and n6.strip() == "1", f"err={err6} n={n6}")

    # Child writes first; parent new effectId of the same source is denied.
    reset()
    src_cf = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","corr-child-first")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_cf_p","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_cf_p",src_cf,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_cf_c","CHILD","child_cf",src_cf,
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999", parent="w_cf_p")
    rc1, out1, err1 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_cf_c","ae_cf_c",
                                 source_body="corr-child-first")
    rc2, out2, err2 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_cf_p","ae_cf_p",
                                 source_body="corr-child-first")
    rc_n, n_p, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_cf_p';")
    record(group, "parent_new_effect_id_after_child_write_denied",
           rc == 0 and rc1 == 0 and last_line(out1) == "1"
           and rc2 != 0 and "effect_digest_mismatch" in err2 and n_p.strip() == "0",
           f"child={err1} parent={err2} n_p={n_p}", sqlstate_from_err(err2))

    # Uncorrelated parent cannot manufacture lineage.
    reset()
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_unc_wh","WEBHOOK","wh_unc","dg_unc_parent",
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    src_stolen = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","stolen")
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_stolen","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_stolen",src_stolen,
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999")
    rc2, out2, err2 = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_fake_child","CHILD","child_fake",src_stolen,
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999", parent="w_unc_wh")
    # Child of unattributed webhook with a *different* source is not the stolen source.
    # Manufacture: PARENT_LINEAGE of unattributed parent with the ADMIN source.
    rc3, out3, err3 = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_fake_child2","CHILD","child_fake2",src_stolen,
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999", parent="w_unc_wh")
    rc4, out4, err4 = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w_stolen',"
        f"'ADMIN_ACTION','admin_stolen','{src_stolen}','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), "
        "'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','999999', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "uncorrelated_parent_cannot_manufacture_freshness",
           rc == 0 and rc3 == 0 and rc4 != 0 and "capture_content_no_longer_fresh" in err4,
           f"cap={err} child={err3} consume={err4}")

    # ----- RE-02 same source, new effect id -----
    reset()
    tx("stocky_privacy_erasure","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_privacy_install_customer_barrier('preq_cr','patt_cr');"
        " SELECT public.stocky_privacy_enumerate_targets('preq_cr');"
        " DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderLineFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"ShopifyOrderFact\"; DELETE FROM public.\"AuditEvent\";"

        "INSERT INTO public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\"(id,\"canonicalDomain\",\"targetShopId\",\"shopRowId\",fence,\"installedAt\") "

        "UPDATE public.\"ShopInstallGeneration\" SET fence='UNINSTALLED', \"shopRowId\"=NULL WHERE id='gen_a'; "
        "UPDATE public.\"PrivacyCompletedTarget\" SET \"completedAt\" = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:49:00+00' "
        "WHERE \"generationId\"=\'gen_a\' AND \"targetKind\"=\'CUSTOMER_REST_ID\' AND \"targetValue\"=\'191167\';")
    src_child = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","replay-body")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_root_re2","WEBHOOK","wh_root_re2",src_child,
          "WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167",
          admitted_at_sql="TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:19:00+00'")
    rc2, out2, err2 = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","work_child_re2","CHILD","child_re2",src_child,
          "PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", parent="work_root_re2",
          admitted_at_sql="TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-20 18:19:00+00'")
    rc3, _, err3 = tx("stocky_runtime","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        gsql("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","work_child_re2"))
    # New effect id, new command/work/source identity, SAME source body.
    rc4, out4, err4 = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_relabel","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_relabel",src_child,
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", command_id="cmd_relabelled_effect")
    record(group, "same_source_new_effect_id_cannot_acquire_fresh_admin_capture",
           rc2 == 0 and rc3 != 0 and "customer_target_attribution_ambiguous" in err3
           and rc4 != 0 and "queued_work_cannot_acquire_fresh_admin_origin" in err4,
           f"child={err2} guard={err3} cap={err4}")
    # Also deny if they try a different effect identity through the host on a
    # separately captured same-source row that lost the race to sighting.
    src_fresh = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","replay-body")
    record(group, "re02_source_digest_stable_across_effect_ids",
           src_child == src_fresh == source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","replay-body"),
           src_child)
    record(group, "re02_effect_digest_changes_with_effect_id",
           effect_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","ae_child")
           != effect_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","ae_relabelled"),
           "ok")

    # Genuinely new source (new body) on same customer target still progresses.
    src_new = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","brand-new-command")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_brand_new","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_brand_new",src_new,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc2, out2, err2 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_brand_new","ae_brand_new",
                                 source_body="brand-new-command")
    record(group, "genuine_new_source_same_customer_still_progresses",
           rc == 0 and rc2 == 0 and last_line(out2) == "1", f"admit={err} host={err2}")

    # Tenant isolation: shop B with same source body is independent.
    src_b = source_commitment("pr7-b.myshopify.com","shop_b","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","replay-body")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_b","pr7-b.myshopify.com","w_b_iso","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_b_iso",src_b,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", req="preq_dr", att="patt_dr")
    rc2, out2, err2 = host_apply("shop_b","pr7-b.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_b_iso","ae_b_iso",
                                 source_body="replay-body", req="preq_dr", att="patt_dr")
    record(group, "tenant_isolation_same_source_body_progresses",
           rc == 0 and rc2 == 0 and last_line(out2) == "1" and src_b != src_child,
           f"admit={err} host={err2}")

    # Pending recovery then sighting then effect.
    reset()
    psql("pr45owner",
        "INSERT INTO public.\"DurableJob\"(id,\"shopId\",\"jobType\",state) "
        "VALUES ('job_re_pend','shop_a','admitted:ADMIN_ACTION','PENDING') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;")
    src_pend = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","pend-body")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_re_pend","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_re_pend",src_pend,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999", job="job_re_pend", mode="BEGIN")
    tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_recover_writer_admission('w_re_pend');")

    rc2, out2, err2 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","999999","w_re_pend","ae_pend",

    record(group, "pending_recovery_then_sighting_cannot_effect",

    # Multi-level lineage rename still denied at capture (AO-03 preserved).
    reset()
    src_ml = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","ml-body")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_ml0","WEBHOOK","wh_ml0",src_ml,"WEBHOOK_PROVIDER_AUTH","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_ml1","CHILD","ch_ml1",src_ml,"PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", parent="w_ml0")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_ml2","CHILD","ch_ml2",src_ml,"PARENT_LINEAGE","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", parent="w_ml1")
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_ml_admin","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_ml",src_ml,
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", command_id="cmd_ml_renamed")
    record(group, "multi_level_lineage_same_source_cannot_capture_admin",
           rc != 0 and "queued_work_cannot_acquire_fresh_admin_origin" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))

    # Missing/pruned evidence: no sighting row remains explicitly non-fresh only when
    # evidence exists. Absence of a row is not a freshness grant beyond capture.
    reset()
    src_miss = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","missing-ev")
    rc, out, err = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_miss","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_miss",src_miss,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "missing_sighting_does_not_invent_nonfreshness", rc == 0, err)
    rc2, out2, err2 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_miss","ae_miss",
                                 source_body="missing-ev")
    record(group, "fresh_admin_without_sighting_still_writes",
           rc2 == 0 and last_line(out2) == "1", err2)

    # Canonicalization: generated ids excluded; body/operation/tenant included.
    rec_src = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","canon-body")
    record(group, "source_commitment_stable_across_generated_ids",
           rec_src == source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","canon-body"),
           rec_src)
    record(group, "source_commitment_changes_with_body",
           rec_src != source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","canon-body-2"),
           "ok")
    record(group, "source_commitment_changes_with_operation",
           rec_src != source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","canon-body",
                                        operation="CUSTOMER_EXPORT"),
           "ok")
    rc, out_null, err_null = psql("pr45owner",
        "SELECT public.stocky_source_commitment('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','CUSTOMER_WRITE','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL);")
    record(group, "source_commitment_null_input_is_strict_null",
           rc == 0 and out_null.strip() == "", f"out={out_null!r} err={err_null}")

    # Duplicate capture after contradiction is not a freshness grant.
    reset()
    src_dup = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","dup-after")
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_dup_after","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_dup_after",src_dup,
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", command_id="cmd_dup_after")
    record(group, "re01_first_capture_before_sighting_succeeds", rc == 0, err)
    tx("stocky_control_plane","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_note_queued_work('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','WEBHOOK','wh_dup_after',"
        f"'{src_dup}','QUEUED_INBOX');")
    rc, out, err = capture_admin("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_dup_after2","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_dup_after",src_dup,
                                 "CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167", command_id="cmd_dup_after")
    record(group, "duplicate_capture_after_contradiction_is_not_freshness_grant",
           rc != 0 and "capture_content_no_longer_fresh" in err, err, sqlstate_from_err(err))
    rc2, out2, err2 = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",
        "SELECT public.stocky_record_writer_admission('pr7-a.myshopify.com','shop_a','w_dup_after',"
        f"'ADMIN_ACTION','admin_dup_after','{src_dup}','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), "
        "'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    record(group, "duplicate_return_cannot_consume_contradicted_capture",
           rc2 != 0 and "capture_content_no_longer_fresh" in err2, err2, sqlstate_from_err(err2))

    # Same source + new work/command/effect ids still denied on the real effect lane.
    reset()
    src_lane = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","lane-body")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_lane1","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_lane1",src_lane,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc, out, err = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_lane1","ae_lane1",

    rc2, out2, err2 = admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_lane2","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_lane2",src_lane,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    record(group, "same_source_new_work_id_cannot_remint_admin_origin",

    rc3, out3, err3 = host_apply("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","w_lane1","ae_lane2",
                                 source_body="lane-body")
    rc_n, n, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"AuditEvent\" WHERE id='ae_lane2';")
    record(group, "same_source_new_effect_id_denied_on_real_effect_lane",
           rc3 != 0 and "effect_digest_mismatch" in err3 and n.strip() == "0",
           f"err={err3} n={n}", sqlstate_from_err(err3))
    # Duplicate-return of same identity+digest is not a remint of a new work.
    reset()
    src_co = source_commitment("pr7-a.myshopify.com","shop_a","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167","coalesce-body")
    admit("shop_a","pr7-a.myshopify.com","w_coal1","ADMIN_ACTION","admin_coal",src_co,
          "ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL","CUSTOMER_REST_ID","191167")
    rc, out, err = tx("stocky_original_admission","shop_a","preq_cr","patt_cr",

        f"'ADMIN_ACTION','admin_coal','{src_co}','pr7-origin-v1', clock_timestamp(), "
        "'ADMIN_SESSION_CURRENT_INSTALL','CUSTOMER_REST_ID','191167', NULL, NULL, 'ATOMIC');")
    rc_n, n_o, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"sourceIdentity\"='admin_coal';")
    rc_w, w2, _ = psql("pr45owner", "SELECT count(*) FROM public.\"WriterAdmissionOrigin\" WHERE \"workId\"='w_coal2';")
    record(group, "duplicate_admission_return_does_not_remint_new_work",
           rc == 0 and n_o.strip() == "1" and w2.strip() == "0",
           f"admit={err} origins={n_o} w_coal2={w2}")


def main() -> int:
    os.makedirs(PROOF_ROOT, exist_ok=True)
    reset()
    g1()
    g2()
    g3()
    g4()
    g5()
    g6()
    g7()
    g8()
    g9()
    g10()
    g11()
    g12()
    g13()
    g14()
    g15()
    g16()
    neg_controls()
    # Clean rerun after function replacements.
    g7()
    g8()
    g9()
    g11()
    g12()
    g13()
    g14()
    g15()
    g16()
    failed = [r for r in RESULTS if not r["ok"]]
    pg = query_pg_version()
    pairs = [(r["group"], r["name"]) for r in RESULTS]
    unique_n = len(set(pairs))
    rerun_n = len(pairs) - unique_n
    by_group: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for r in RESULTS:
        g = by_group.setdefault(r["group"], {"records": 0, "unique": 0})
        g["records"] += 1
        key = (r["group"], r["name"])
        if key not in seen:
            g["unique"] += 1
            seen.add(key)
    payload = {
        "results_json_class": "run_log_nondeterministic_timings_not_a_verification_artifact",
        "postgres_queried": pg,
        "host": f"{PGHOST}:{PGPORT}",
        "proof_root": PROOF_ROOT,
        "total": len(RESULTS),
        "pass": len(RESULTS) - len(failed),
        "fail": len(failed),
        "unique_assertions": unique_n,
        "declared_reruns": rerun_n,
        "by_group": by_group,
        "results": RESULTS,
        "failed": failed,
        "historical_tf_115_record_packet": {
            "records": 115,
            "unique": 89,
            "declared_reruns": 26,
            "note": "115 records ≠ 115 unique assertions",
        },
